verdict.rationale: Temporal Cloud is explicitly a managed control plane where customers run their own Workers connecting over mTLS, with data encryption designed so Temporal Cloud never accesses sensitive workflow data (temporal-docs-31, temporal-docs-13/44). This matches the exact 'bring your own workers, vendor manages orchestration, data stays in your network' architecture. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on verification of the network-isolation claim, and no detailed architecture diagram or third-party audit confirming Workers-only-outbound connectivity model.
